title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Crans-Montana, 10–12 September, 2015–2025
claims: For Crans-Montana on 10–12 September in 2015–2025 there are 33 daily records: daily maximum 6.4–23.9 °C (median 17.8 °C), daily minimum 1.2–10.1 °C (median 6.7 °C), 11 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 2 days with at least 5 mm.
The station is Crans-Montana village at about 1,500 m, not the Gemmi Pass, Cabane Wildstrubel or Rawyl Pass.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 10–12 September; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
